pages.title: EFT / Tapping and Energy Healing in Texas | Three Hands Healing
pages.description: EFT / Tapping sessions, energy healing, bodywork, Qi Gong and Family Constellations with Maria at Three Hands Healing. Online or in person in Texas.
h1: Feel good in your body, at peace in your mind, aligned in your life.

findings.title: a visitor can reach the business
findings.message: there is no way to contact or book: no phone link, email link, form or booking link anywhere on the site (the "Book a session" button only scrolls the page)
findings.fix: Get one real contact route from the owner (a booking link, a phone number, or an email) and wire the main button to it.

findings.title: the copy does not say the page is unfinished
findings.message: the page tells visitors it is not finished: "n · Sessions in Texas Booking and contact details will be added at launch getting healthier and happier Three Hands Heal"
findings.fix: Get the missing detail from the owner (booking link, phone, prices) and replace the line.

findings.title: photos are not oversized
findings.message: 1 image(s) weigh more than 400 KB: /img/photos/maria-arch-red-door.jpg (432 KB, 1066×1600)
findings.fix: Resize to the width it is shown at and serve WebP or AVIF; on Netlify use /.netlify/images?url=…&w=…&fm=webp.

findings.title: the phone number is on the page and tappable
findings.message: no phone number on the site
findings.fix: Ask the owner whether they take calls or texts. If yes, add the number as a tel: link; if no, leave it out on purpose.

findings.title: the share image loads and has the right shape
findings.message: og:image is 1066×1600 (portrait): preview cards crop to about 1.91:1, so faces and words get cut
findings.engineFix: Engine sites: the current engine builds a 1200×630 JPEG from the Featured photo; run sync-engine for this client.

findings.title: the LocalBusiness data is complete and true
findings.fix: Confirm the fact with the owner, then add it. Never fill it with a guess.

findings.title: the page works at phone width
findings.message: 3 link(s) or button(s) are smaller than 44px on a phone

findings.title: the page works at phone width
findings.message: 12 text block(s) render under 12px on a phone

findings.title: AI search crawlers are not shut out by accident
findings.message: no AI-crawler rules in robots.txt: every crawler is allowed by the default group

findings.title: sitemap dates are present and plausible
findings.message: the sitemap has no <lastmod> dates. Google uses lastmod when it is accurate; changefreq and priority are ignored
findings.fix: Emit the real last-edit date per URL.

findings.title: photos are not oversized
findings.message: 2 image(s) over 120 KB are JPEG/PNG: /img/photos/maria-arch-laughing.jpg (272 KB), /img/photos/maria-arch-open-hand.jpg (371 KB)
findings.fix: WebP or AVIF is usually half the size at the same quality.

findings.title: /index.html is not a second copy of the home page
findings.message: https://three-hands-healing.netlify.app/index.html answers 200 (the canonical tag points at https://three-hands-healing.netlify.app/)
findings.fix: 301 it to the folder URL so there is one address.
findings.engineFix: Engine sites: the current engine already redirects /index.html; run sync-engine for this client.

findings.title: the site connects to the business's profiles
findings.message: no link to a Google Business Profile or a review page
findings.fix: Once the Business Profile is verified, link to it (and to its "leave a review" link) from the site.

findings.title: the title fits in a search result
findings.message: the title is 63 characters and may be cut off in results ("EFT / Tapping and Energy Healing in Texas | Three Hands Healing")
findings.fix: Trim toward 60 characters if the cut would hide something important.

findings.title: the link preview is complete
findings.message: link-preview polish missing: og:image:width/height (lets the first share render without a delay)
findings.engineFix: Engine sites: all emitted by the current engine; run sync-engine for this client.

findings.title: the LocalBusiness data is complete and true
findings.message: HealthAndBeautyBusiness at @graph[1]: no "address". Fine for a service-area business that hides its address; add at least addressLocality + addressRegion + addressCountry once the owner confirms the city
findings.fix: Confirm the fact with the owner, then add it. Never fill it with a guess.

findings.title: the LocalBusiness data is complete and true
findings.message: HealthAndBeautyBusiness at @graph[1]: no opening hours (openingHoursSpecification). Add them once the owner confirms hours; by-appointment businesses can skip this
findings.fix: Confirm the fact with the owner, then add it. Never fill it with a guess.

findings.title: the LocalBusiness data is complete and true
findings.fix: Confirm the fact with the owner, then add it. Never fill it with a guess.

findings.title: the LocalBusiness data is complete and true
findings.message: HealthAndBeautyBusiness at @graph[1]: no "sameAs" links (Business Profile, Instagram, Facebook). Add them once the profiles exist
findings.fix: Confirm the fact with the owner, then add it. Never fill it with a guess.
